technique_name: Write a paragraph about the evolution of the automobile.
description: The evolution of the automobile has come a long way. The first internal combustion engine-powered car was invented in 1885. Since then, the automobile has been through many iterations, with the invention of the self-starter, power windows, traction control, cruise control, and many more features that make the driving experience easier and safer.
